description: Missing, noisy, or non-stationary input prices.
mitigation_strategy: Pre-check quality gates and validation dependencies.

description: Inadvertent inclusion of future data or next return.
mitigation_strategy: Strict no-lookahead guards and chronological sort assertions.

description: Accidental ingestion of full article text or HTML.
mitigation_strategy: Forbidden column policies and metadata-only filters.
Disabled execution checks intercepting fit/predict calls.
Linkage to Phase 142 drift monitoring contracts.

description: Treating feature attribution as causal certainty.
mitigation_strategy: Model card limitations and non-causal disclosures.
Purged split requirements and walk-forward contract placeholders.

description: Unauthorized connection of broker trading APIs.
mitigation_strategy: Zero broker integration settings and blocked status.

description: Misinterpreting research scores as investment advice.
mitigation_strategy: Prominent non-signal disclaimers across all reports.

description: Destructive overwriting or deletion of source data.
mitigation_strategy: Source preservation guards preventing file mutation.

description: Exposure of API keys or credentials in reports.
mitigation_strategy: Credential output prohibition and automated scanning.
